ring: Vegeta is calling. He will be insulted if you let it ring.
Incoming call: the Prince of all Saiyans. Answer.
Vegeta's ringing. You can hear the gravity room humming behind him.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You. I've been looking at your record. You have excuses.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Busy. Everyone is busy. Busy is what weak people say when they mean 'I chose something else'.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Everyone weak has excuses.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I've trained with broken ribs. I've trained after losing. I've trained on days I'd rather have destroyed a planet.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I'm not telling you to do that. You'd break. I'm telling you that a reason is not permission.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So do it anyway, even a little.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Even a little. A little is not nothing. Nothing is for cowards.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Are you proud of your work?

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Sometimes. Pathetic. You should be proud every day, or doing something worth being proud of.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I didn't say brag. I said be proud. Learn the difference.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Pride is why I train. I refuse to be anything less than my best. Anything less is beneath a prince.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You're not a prince. But you can still refuse to do sloppy work.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So hold myself to a high standard.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Hold yourself to your own standard. Not other people's. Theirs are usually too low.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Do you have a rival?

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Then you're training without a target. Find one.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Good. Hate them a little. Respect them a lot.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Kakarot is the most irritating creature in the universe. He's also the reason I'm this strong.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Every time he passes me, I train until I pass him. Then he does it again. It never ends.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Who should my rival be?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Yourself from last week. Beat him. Then beat next week's you. That one's harder. Good.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Did you skip something today because you didn't feel like it?

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I knew it.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Hm. Then this is for tomorrow.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your feelings don't lift weights. Your feelings don't run. Your feelings don't do anything except complain.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Train when you feel like it. Train harder when you don't. That's where the real gains are.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's intense.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I'm a Saiyan. Intense is the default setting. You can turn it down. Not off.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Something's hard for you right now. I can tell.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Because you're quiet. Weak people get quiet when things are hard.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Good.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Hard means you're at the edge of what you can do. That's the only place you grow.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Easy is maintenance. Hard is progress. Don't run from it, lean into it.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: And if it's too hard?

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Then do a smaller hard thing. But never pick easy just because it's easy.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I trained today. I trained yesterday. I will train tomorrow.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Every. Single. Day.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Especially on holidays. Everyone else is resting.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Do you know why I'm stronger than nearly everyone in the universe? Not talent. I had talent, but so did others.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I never stopped. While they celebrated, I trained. While they rested, I trained.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: I'm not sure I can do it every day.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Then do something every day. Even the smallest thing. The streak matters more than the size.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I lost today. To Kakarot. Again.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Don't pity me.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I'm furious. Which means I'm fine.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Do you know what I do when I lose? I don't sulk. Well. I sulk for ten minutes. Then I go back to the gravity room.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Losing is information. It tells you exactly where you're weak. Then you fix it.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Ten minutes of sulking, then back to work.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You may have ten minutes too. Not eleven.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I used to fight only for myself. For my pride.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: It was. I didn't notice until it wasn't.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Now I have a family. A woman who shouts at me. A son who thinks he can beat me.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I still fight for my pride. But I also fight so they're safe.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's a good reason.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Find yours. A reason bigger than you will make you get up on days your own reasons aren't enough. Don't tell anyone I said something soft.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You do know you're speaking to royalty.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: The Prince of all Saiyans. Get it right.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: ...Not anymore.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: My planet is gone. Most of my people are gone. The title is all that's left.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I carry it anyway. Not because anyone makes me. Because I refuse to let it mean nothing.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's a lot to carry.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It's a lot. It makes me strong. Choose something worth carrying, and carry it every day.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I'm in the gravity room right now. Three hundred times normal gravity. Don't drop your phone, you'd break your foot.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Slowly, at first. Then normally. That's the point.

choice.text: Bulma says you keep breaking it.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: The machine is weak.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I raise the gravity a little at a time. My body adapts. Then I raise it again.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: If I jumped straight to the top, I'd be crushed. Step by step is the only way.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Like adding a bit more to a habit each week.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Exactly like that. Don't go from zero to everything. Go from zero to slightly more than zero.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You'll hear people say Kakarot and I are friends. We are not friends.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Rivals. Eternal rivals.

choice.text: He talks about you a lot.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Of course he does. I'm the most interesting thing in his life besides food.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: When I first came to Earth, I came to destroy him. He beat me. A low-class soldier beat the prince.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I've been trying to settle that score ever since. It's been years. I'm still trying.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's a long time to stay motivated.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: When something truly matters to you, you don't need motivation. You need time. Use yours well.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: My son challenged me to a fight this morning.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I don't let anyone win.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Old enough to think he can beat me. Young enough to be wrong.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: He lost. Then he asked to train again tomorrow. Same time.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: ...I said yes.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's sweet.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It's not sweet. It's training. He needs discipline. And I may enjoy it slightly. Don't repeat that.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I still wear my old battle armour sometimes. Bulma's made me new versions, but the design is the same.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: It reminds me where I came from.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Comfort is for the weak.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I was a soldier before I was anything else. The armour reminds me what I was, and what I refuse to be again.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Keep something that reminds you how far you've come. Old shoes. An old photo. Your first day's numbers.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: The first day's power level.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Yes. Look at it when you feel weak. You aren't that anymore.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I lost my temper and destroyed the training dummies again.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: All twelve. Bulma's making thirteen now. Reinforced.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: They looked smug.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I've always had a temper. It used to run my life. Now I mostly aim it at training.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Mostly. The dummies are an exception.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: At least you're aiming it somewhere useful.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Anger is fuel. Learn to put it in the engine instead of setting the house on fire. I'm still learning that. Don't tell anyone.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Do you know why muscles get stronger? Most people don't. Listen.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: That's the start. Not the reason.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: When you push a muscle harder than it's used to, it adapts. It rebuilds stronger, so next time it's ready.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Trainers call it progressive overload. Do the same weight forever and you stop growing. Add a little more, a little more.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So I have to keep raising the bar.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Slowly. Too much at once and you get hurt. Too little and nothing happens. Find the edge and push it gently. Even I do that. Mostly.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your heart beats around a hundred thousand times a day.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Every day. Without asking permission.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Mine beats however I tell it to.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It's the hardest-working muscle you have. It never takes a rest day. Ever.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Train it. Run, swim, climb stairs. A strong heart makes everything else possible.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So cardio matters.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Cardio matters. I hate admitting it. Kakarot loves cardio. Insufferable.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Bulma told me the gravity on the planet Jupiter would make you weigh about two and a half times as much as you do now.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Easily. That's nothing.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: You'd be slow. Not crushed. There's a difference.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Gravity is just resistance. The more you have, the more your body has to work. That's why I train in my room.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your habits are resistance too. Each one is a little weight you choose to carry.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: And they make me stronger.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: If you carry them every day, yes. If you put them down every other day, they make you tired.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Astronauts living in space lose muscle and bone, because nothing pulls on them.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Their bodies get lazy. Floating is too easy.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: They train. About two hours a day.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: On the space station, they strap themselves to machines and exercise for hours, every day, just to stay the same.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Do you see? Without resistance, the body wastes away. Even in the most advanced place your species has built.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So comfort makes you weak.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Too much comfort makes everyone weak. A little resistance every day is the price of staying strong.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: You train to music, don't you? The rhythm game. With me.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: It does. There's research on it.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Hm. That's acceptable.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Studies show music with a strong beat can make hard exercise feel easier, and people tend to move in time with it without trying.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your body likes a rhythm. Daily habits are a rhythm too. Same time, same order, every day.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So routine is like a beat.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Yes. Find your tempo and keep it. Don't miss beats.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Are you sore from training?

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Good.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Then you didn't train hard enough. Joking. Partly.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: That soreness usually peaks a day or two after new exercise. It's tiny damage in the muscle, being repaired.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: People used to blame it on lactic acid. They were wrong. The burn during a set and the ache the next day are different things.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: So the ache means I'm rebuilding.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Rebuilding stronger. Eat properly and sleep, or the repair takes longer. Even I sleep. Briefly.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Listen carefully. I won't repeat myself.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your streak is {streak} days.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Acceptable. More than acceptable. Don't let it make you soft.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I didn't compliment you. I said 'acceptable'.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Good. Then a year. Then forever. That's how it's done.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: A beginning. Weak, but a beginning.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Everyone's weak at the beginning. Even I was. Briefly. Very briefly.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Don't tell me. Show me tomorrow.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Zero. Pathetic.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: ...Fine. I've been at zero too. More than once. After every defeat.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I got up and trained. Do the same. Today.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Then start now, not tomorrow. Tomorrow is where weaklings keep their plans.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Now stop wasting my time on the phone and go train.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your weakest habit is {weak_habit}.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Then why is it still weak?

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Everything worth doing is hard. That's how you know it's worth doing.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: A warrior attacks his weakness. He doesn't hide it.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Tomorrow, do {weak_habit} first. Before anything else. Before you have a chance to talk yourself out of it.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: First thing.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: First thing. Weakness is strongest when you give it time to argue.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I sensed your energy from across the city. Don't flatter yourself, it wasn't difficult.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Your power level is {power}.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Over a thousand. Not bad. Still nowhere near mine.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Higher than you can count.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: You are not catching up. But you're improving. That's enough for now.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Weak. But rising. Rising is what matters.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Do everything, every day. No skipped days. That's the whole secret.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Be proud of the effort. Numbers are the receipt.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: That's barely a reading. Even the Earthlings on the street are higher.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I'm not here to comfort you. I'm here to tell you to train.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: ...Fine. Check one thing off before this call ends. Go. I'll wait. Briefly.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Go. Raise that number before I check again.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Bulma left your numbers on the kitchen table. I read them. Don't make it a thing.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: {week_checkoffs} habits this week. And {week_missed} missed.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Too many missed. I don't accept that.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Don't say it. Do it.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Then make your habits harder to break. Smaller, earlier, unavoidable.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: A few misses. Sloppy, not hopeless.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Sloppy. Tighten it up.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Don't aim for not hopeless. Aim for flawless.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Nothing missed. Hm.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: It was a sound. Interpret it however you like.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Then do it again. One flawless week is luck. Ten is a warrior.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: That's all. Train.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Bulma said I should 'check in on my student'. A ridiculous phrase. Yet here I am.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Our bond is at level {bond_level}. I keep count.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I've decided you're worth my time. That's rare. Don't waste it.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Good.

choice.text: That means a lot from you.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: It should. I don't say it twice.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: You're still proving yourself. That's fine. Everyone has to.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Show up. Every day. Until I stop noticing you show up, because it's just what you do.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: We'll see.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: ...Now go. I have a gravity room to break.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Kakarot came to my house and ate my lunch.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: He said it 'looked lonely'. It was not lonely. It was mine.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: We fought. Then Bulma made us both stop. Then he ate dessert too.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: He's an idiot. A powerful idiot. The most frustrating combination in the universe.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: He never takes anything seriously, and he still somehow gets stronger. It drives me mad.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Maybe that's his secret.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: His secret is that he loves fighting more than anything. I'll never admit that it works. You didn't hear me say it.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Bulma said I'm 'banned' from the gravity room until she repairs it.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Nothing. It broke itself, near me.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: She owns the house, the machine, and the kitchen. She can do what she likes.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: She's the only person on this planet who isn't afraid of me. She shouts at me like I'm a normal man.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: ...It's refreshing. Don't tell her.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Your secret's safe.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It had better be. I know where you live. Well, Bulma does. Same thing.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: The Namekian was meditating on the roof again.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: He's very quiet. Suspiciously quiet.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: He's good at sitting still. That's a skill for a statue.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: He told me I should meditate. Me. The Prince of all Saiyans. Sitting still. Ridiculous.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: ...I tried it for five minutes. It was annoying. And I slept well that night. Which proves nothing.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Maybe a little.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: It proves nothing. And if you tell him, I'll deny it.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: I met the old turtle hermit. He was asleep in a deck chair at noon.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Old isn't an excuse. Well. Maybe at three hundred it is.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: So everyone keeps telling me.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Kakarot says everything he knows started with that old man's chores. Milk. Fields. Swimming.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Chores. The strongest fighter on Earth started with chores.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: Small things add up.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Small things add up. Don't you dare quote me to him.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: Everyone trained together at Capsule Corp today. It was chaos.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: Me, obviously. Kakarot will say otherwise. Kakarot is wrong.

then.speaker: VEGETA
then.text: I don't 'enjoy' training. I conquer it.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: The Namekian meditated. The old man napped. Kakarot ate. Bulma shouted about the lawn.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: And I trained. Like I always do. While they're all distracted, I get stronger.

lines.speaker: YOU
lines.text: That's your secret.

lines.speaker: VEGETA
lines.text: That's the only secret there is. Do the work while everyone else is busy doing something else.
